Existing files were edited in place (CheckConflicts.test.ts, appointments.router.caller.test.ts, entitlement) rather than weakened; no assertion deletions were looked for beyond that and were not sampled line by line.

No it.skip, .only, test.todo or xit added. The only hit is tests/integration/availability.test.ts:96 'describeDb = DB_URL ? describe : describe.skip', an env guard copied from the existing integration suites. Two conditional ctx.skip() paths exist in the RLS session test (no 'authenticated' role, no grants) and are logged as disclosed skips.

The 5 skips are exactly the 5 it() blocks of the pre-existing rls-tenant-isolation suite (file untouched by this diff). It skips via a beforeAll probe ('SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated; SELECT 1 FROM accounts') plus beforeEach ctx.skip, a deliberate, commented design for DBs without Supabase grants. The skip is NOT hiding PG-202 coverage: availability.test.ts has 13 plain it() + one it.each of 6 = 20 tests, and the run reports exactly 20 passed, so its own RLS session check (:352) ran and passed rather than skipping. This is inferred from the count, since the log is not verbose. Caveat: CI without DATABASE_URL skips the whole file silently (see finding).

availability.router.test.ts:107, availability-enforcement.test.ts:40 and appointments.router.caller.test.ts:991 pin Date with vi.useFakeTimers({ toFake: ['Date'] }) + setSystemTime(NOW) around the PG-202 blocks. The remaining new Date() in caller.test.ts lines 39-43, 464, 519 are pre-existing mock payloads not compared against now.

findings.issue: The daily cap is count-then-insert (not atomic). Two concurrent creates at the cap can both pass. It is waived as PG-202-AVAILABILITY-KNOWN-LIMITS-001 and marked pending owner confirmation, and there is no concurrency test for it, so the behaviour is untested by design.
findings.fix: Leave as a documented limit, or add a test that asserts the limitation (so a future atomic fix flips it). Owner confirmation is a NEEDS_HUMAN item, not a Quality blocker.

findings.fix: Confirm that the CI integration job sets DATABASE_URL so this file runs there; no code change needed.

limitations: Judged from logs and by reading tests; per instructions nothing was run (no tests, coverage, builds or servers). Test counts and percentages are quoted from the logs, not reproduced. The claim that the availability RLS session test passed (not skipped) is inferred from 20 passed + 5 skipped = 14 `it` blocks with one it.each of 6 plus the 5 rls blocks; the integration log is not verbose. Regression coverage of existing suites is taken from the green full api and web runs, not from a line-by-line review of edits to existing tests. Mutation testing was not configured or run. Verdict is WARN rather than PASS because of the web branch/function coverage on new files, the web full run overlapping the a11y edits, and the unrepresentative summary.tsv row; under a strict reading of the Quality agent's 90% rule, with no WARN band, the scoped web aggregate (branches 85.32, functions 83.78) and CheckConflicts branches (70) would be FAIL, so the lead should decide which reading applies. No fixed-date wall-clock time bombs, skipped or focused tests were found.
